title: ALLEGRI SENT OFF, BANNED, THEN JOKES IT COULD BE FOUR MATCHES
description:
A red card, a late equaliser, and a ban the manager joked about himself.

Napoli drew 3-3 with Roma, and Allegri saw a straight red after the late equaliser. He says the goal was a foul. The goal stood. His argument did not.

He got a two-match ban and a €10,000 fine. Napoli first said they would appeal. Then Allegri dropped it and joked the ban could grow to four.

He misses Monza, then Juventus, his old club, where he won five Serie A titles. Napoli are struggling in the league, so the timing is not great.
